stable.release_notes: AgentNEO 3.0.26 fixes Resource Governor fairness and diagnostic scheduling: FIFO inference waiters, visible lease ownership, governor-aware diagnostic probes, bounded resource waits, and correct Memory handling of resource-slot timeouts. It preserves the 3.0.25 GPT-OSS, Ollama endpoint and CUDA speech-runtime repairs. The selective updater is validated from AgentNEO 3.0.25.
